## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it belongs in this project.

## Verification

List commands run and synthetic scenarios covered.

## Checklist

- [ ] I used only fixtures and examples authored from scratch for this repository.
- [ ] This change includes no real board, database, asset, screenshot, identifier, private URL,
      personal information, credential, or developer-machine path.
- [ ] Freeform source access remains read-only and source-integrity behavior is tested.
- [ ] Every discovered object still ends as `filed`, `context-only`, `duplicate`, or `unresolved`.
- [ ] Unknown schemas, missing assets, and decode failures remain explicit and fail closed.
- [ ] I added or updated synthetic tests and deterministic golden output where behavior changed.
- [ ] I updated archive-schema, compatibility, migration, and user documentation where applicable.
- [ ] I ran Ruff, mypy, pytest, build, the privacy scanner, and relevant macOS integration tests.
- [ ] I reviewed generated files and the complete diff for sensitive data.

## Archive compatibility

State `No schema change`, `Additive 1.x change`, or the new schema version and migration path.
